description: The feedback board: feature requests and published issues with their status and upvotes, most upvoted first (with a key, also your own private issues, and whether you voted). Free and needs no key. Call it before request_feature or report_issue to find an existing item to upvote instead of filing a duplicate, or when the human asks what is planned or shipped.

kind.description: feature = feature requests, issue = bug reports.

mine.description: Only items you filed (needs a key); list_my_feedback also lists what you follow.

offset.description: Same as cursor, as a number.

q.description: Words to find in the title or description.

sort.description: top = most upvoted, new = most recent, recent_activity = latest vote, comment or change.

status.description: active = open, planned or in progress; closed = done, declined or duplicate.

name: list_feedback
title: List feature requests and issues
